episodes.title: Inside Anthropic’s IPO + How AI Agents Spy on Your Messages
episodes.about: Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, has released the most detailed account of its business yet, as it prepares for its IPO. We break down the biggest surprises in its S-1 filing and explain what the numbers tell us about the AI bubble. Then, Signal president Meredith Whittaker joins us in the studio to discuss the existential threat facing private messaging and end-to-end encryption. Between governments demanding backdoor access to private conversations and AI agents that can see everything on our devices, she warns, “we are looking at the elimination of the possibility to provide privacy.”
episodes.why: Always-include show: Roose and Newton break down Anthropic's S-1 surprises, then Signal's Meredith Whittaker warns that agents able to see everything on our devices could end private messaging.

episodes.title: AI Can Now Create Worlds You Can Change in Real Time
episodes.about: Google’s Genie 4 brings AI-generated worlds closer to reality, with live prompting, native audio, and more realistic interactions. NLW explores what this means for gaming, robotics, and the path from impressive demos to useful tools. Plus: Anthropic’s one-person biotech acquisition and the debate over access to OpenAI’s scientific breakthroughs.
episodes.why: Google's Genie 4 generates worlds you can change live, with native audio; NLW works through what that means for gaming and robotics, plus Anthropic's one-person biotech acquisition.

episodes.title: Terence Tao on how AI math solutions miss the point
episodes.about: In a matter of months, AI has transformed the field of mathematics. In September, OpenAI claimed that an AI model solved the million-dollar Navier-Stokes equation. Then, a few weeks later, OpenAI shared results for more than 350 previously unsolved math problems. The news has prompted an existential conversation among mathematicians: In an age of AI, what’s the role of the human mathematician? It’s a question that Terence Tao, largely considered one of the greatest mathematicians of this generation, is reckoning with right now. He speaks with Flora about how AI has upended the mathematics world, and why the real value of mathematics lies in the journey, not just the answer.
episodes.why: Discovery pick — Science Friday is the long-running public-radio science show: Terence Tao explains why AI claiming Navier-Stokes and solving 350 unsolved problems still misses what math is for.

episodes.title: The Brutal Reality of Building Agentic Products Today with Daniel Jeffries - #782
episodes.about: AI agents are becoming accessible to everyone, raising the bar for developers building the next generation of agent products. When capable, general-purpose agents are available out of the box, differentiation increasingly comes down to the architectural decisions and specialized experiences that make an agent uniquely valuable. In this episode, Dan Jeffries, creator of Nautilo, joins us to discuss what he's learned building a platform for personal and collaborative AI agents. We explore his approach to persistent memory, coordinating work across people and agents, managing private context, and designing deterministic tools that complement LLM capabilities.
episodes.why: Dan Jeffries, creator of Nautilo, on what actually differentiates an agent product now: persistent memory, private context, and deterministic tools alongside the model.

episodes.title: Why Silicon Valley Wants to Leave Humanity Behind
episodes.about: Behind the AI race, there's a philosophy with an intellectual lineage and a body of work that holds that human beings are a defective early draft, that the things that make us humans are bugs to be fixed, that this planet is expendable and we can move on to the next. And that the suffering of real people today is a rounding error against the value of a cosmic future. Broadly speaking, these ideas fit under the umbrella of transhumanism. You might hear it referred to as techno-optimism or accelerationism. Twenty years ago, these were the beliefs of an ideological fringe in Silicon Valley. Today, they are held by many of the people who build and govern the most powerful technology in human history.
episodes.why: Discovery pick — Your Undivided Attention is the Center for Humane Technology's show, new here and out today: it traces the transhumanist ideas behind the AI race and argues for a pro-human alternative.
